NLCIL and Indian Oil sign pact for renewable energy projects

NLC India Limited (NLCIL) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL). The agreement focuses on the development of large-scale renewable energy projects. These projects are intended to be located in Tamil Nadu.
